This Halloween, we’re bringing together an all-woman, non-binary, and queer lineup of local artists, DJs, painters, flow artists, and vendors to create a night you won't forget.

events.name: NEIL! Martin Zellar’s Tribute To Neil Diamond
events.description: Martin Zellar and his band pay tribute to the iconic music of legendary performer, Neil Diamond. Performing some of the most popular songs in the world, including hits like "Sweet Caroline," "Cherry, Cherry," "Forever in Blue Jeans," "Song Sung Blue," "I Am I Said," "Solitary Man," "America," "Cracklin' Rosie," and many more!

events.name: Little River Band
events.description: Little River Band garnered huge chart success with multi-platinum albums and chart-topping hits in the 70s and 80s.

events.name: Rockin’ Hollywoods ‘Halloween Dance’
events.description: Get ready to dance the night away at the Rockin’ Hollywoods Halloween Dance at Medina Entertainment Center! Join us on Saturday, October 31 for a night of classic rock ’n’ roll hits, a spirited costume contest, and non-stop fun.
